entities.summary: Ulf Lundkvist is a Swedish comic creator, illustrator, and painter. A nostalgia buff in love with the 1940s, 1950s, and 1960s, Lundkvist depicts the "old Sweden" with humor and affection, small towns and countryside and anachronistic places where time seems to stand still.
